body.name: Bias-aware atom-fallback interval
body.construction: Let \(t_\alpha=\sqrt{\log(12J/\alpha)/2}\), \(b_0=t_\alpha/\sqrt{|I_0|}\), and \(b_1=t_\alpha/\sqrt{|I_1|}\). For each \(x\), set \(B_x=Lh_n^\beta\sum_{i\in I_2}|w_{ix}|+t_\alpha(\sum_{i\in I_2}w_{ix}^2)^{1/2}\) and \(D_x=(\widehat b_x+b_1)B_x+b_1\) on \(\Omega_x\), while \(D_x=\widehat b_x+b_1\) off \(\Omega_x\). Define \(\mathrm{CI}_n=[\widehat\theta_n-b_0-\sum_xD_x,\widehat\theta_n+b_0+\sum_xD_x]\cap[0,1]\).
